items.text: For the second straight day, the Ravens listed QB Lamar Jackson as a full participant at today’s practice.
items.why: First full since Week 4 ankle; second consecutive full.
items.implication: Poised for return vs Bills; unlocks offense.

items.text: After being limited at practice Wednesday, the Patriots listed WR AJ Brown as a non-participant at practice today due to his ankle and knee injuries.
items.why: Knee flared up (added to ankle); not spotted at practice.
items.implication: Status for Sunday up in the air; monitor Friday.
corroboration: @RapSheet: knee issue flared, status up in air

items.text: One day after he didn’t practice, the Bengals listed WR Ja'Marr Chase as a full participant in today’s practice.
items.why: Ankle/rest DNP Wednesday; full Thursday indicates maintenance not major issue.
items.implication: Expected to play and start Week 8 vs Titans; no snap concerns.

items.text: Zay Flowers is my WR5 this week. Lamar Jackson is expected back, and I LOVE what that means for Flowers.
items.implication: Strong start/sit upgrade to WR5 range.
corroboration: @adamlevitan: Flowers NFL YPRR lead + Lamar unlock

items.text: Seahawks designated RB Jadarian Price for return to practice.
items.implication: Eligible to play soon; role in crowded backfield TBD.

items.text: Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) and WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) DNP Wednesday but both returned as full participants Thursday; expected fine for Sunday.
items.why: Wed DNP (shoulder/ankle, some rest context); Thu full return, downplayed.
items.implication: No workload concerns vs Vikings; locked starts.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle suffered an aggravation of his previous chest injury on the reverse last week and his status for Sunday vs the Chiefs will be determined at a later time; availability based on how practice goes.
items.why: Chest aggravation; DNP Wed noted in reports.

items.text: Ravens 6th in yards per play despite Huntley 50% snaps. Zay Flowers leads NFL in yards per route run despite 64% targets from Huntley. Very excited to see how hard they cook with healthy Lamar.
items.why: Elite YPRR efficiency even without Lamar.
items.implication: Massive ceiling boost with Lamar return.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson (illness) officially doesn't practice Thursday.
items.implication: Likely plays but monitor; low snap share recently.

items.text: Pat Thorman’s Week 8 rankings are live (snaps/pace focus).
items.why: Updated rankings incorporating latest practice/role data.
items.implication: Use for start/sit and ROS adjustments.

items.text: Jadarian Price is BACK. But can you put him right back into your fantasy football lineup?
items.why: Designated return but crowded Seahawks backfield.

items.text: I do think it’s time to move on and move forward with Jonah Coleman (DEN backfield pod with Levitan/Silva).
items.why: Return and role expansion in Broncos backfield.

items.text: Truly special stuff from Jaxon Smith-Njigba. Loses Klint Kubiak. Not many other dynamic threats around him. Defensive coordinators shading coverage. Entire stadium knows where ball is going. Doesn't matter. JSN ripping off 9 more actual fantasy points than his opportunity would imply.
items.why: Massive FP overperform vs opportunity despite scheme/coverage hits.

items.text: Lions in full-PPR ppg: Jahmyr Gibbs RB1, 3.9 clear of Kenneth Walker; Amon-Ra St. Brown WR4, behind only JSN/Puka/Lamb; Sam LaPorta TE6; Jameson Williams WR24. Goff QB2.
items.why: Zero surprise given defensive woes, schedule, concentration, talent.
items.implication: Continue starting Gibbs/St. Brown as locked RB1/WR1 options.
